about_the_game:
End of the line. All passengers must disembark

In The Last Train, a short first-person psychological horror game, an everyday commute turns into a nightmare when you accidentally fall asleep on the subway. Upon waking, you find yourself at the end of the line in a forgotten station, abandoned and submerged in darkness. But you're not alone; something lurks in the shadows, watching and tracking your every move.

Explore the sinister corridors and hidden corners of the last station as you desperately seek a way back to safety. Every sound, every movement could indicate that whatever is pursuing you is closer than you think. Keep calm, solve disturbing puzzles, and uncover clues to reveal the dark secrets hidden within this forsaken station.

Can you escape before the entity catches you?

Features

  • First-person horror experience with touches of humor

  • You are chased by a famous social media character

  • Intense experience lasting approximately 15 minutes

Prepare yourself for a one-way trip into fear. The last station awaits... and not everyone returns.
